== Walkthrough ==
There is a parasite/creature that shoots from a plant and hits you in the head. This parasite will then force you to walk forward and goes to the opposite side once it contacts the bright light. You will then walk down a steep slope, which has a pit at the bottom. and you should jump over it.

Next, you will encounter a crate and you have to jump over it. When the bright light forces you to turn around, you have to push the crate under the ceiling creature, then climb that crate. The parasite eventually gets removed, and you can freely proceed to the next chapter.
